premises.text: Reality-TV post can require up to 17 hours of work per finished minute
premises.evidence_span: one minute of the final product takes up to 17 hours of post-production

premises.text: Email, calendars, calls, and spreadsheets are the status-quo coordination stack
premises.evidence_span: sifting through emails with long threads where someone hits reply all, scheduling meetings on calendars, long phone calls with people in multiple time zones

premises.text: Link-based viewing rooms collect timestamped stakeholder feedback on the cut
premises.evidence_span: all Paul needs to do is drop in a link, and he creates a viewing room

premises.text: Review digests make feedback assignable and exportable into editing software timelines
premises.evidence_span: Paul could come in and say, OK, that's an important one we've got to turn into an edit. He can then immediately assign it to his editor

premises.text: Browser-based product using existing hosting requires little IT work
premises.evidence_span: it's browser-based, and we leverage existing hosting infrastructure

premises.text: Project-based pricing serves small teams affordably with upside for larger clients
premises.evidence_span: make it affordable for small teams while keep on producing upsides for larger clients

premises.text: Native Adobe integration plus forthcoming MPAA compliance reach studio buyers
